one_liner: Communications platform for SMS, Voice, Email, and messaging APIs.
auth_notes: Twilio uses Account SID and Auth Token (Basic Auth) or API Keys/Secrets for REST API requests, and JWT Access Tokens for client SDKs.
access_notes: Sign up for a free Twilio trial account and get test credits.
api_notes: Over 1,800 endpoints across 30+ products covering SMS, Voice, Video, Messaging, and TaskRouter via REST.

auth.quote: API keys are the preferred way to authenticate with Twilio's REST APIs. With API keys, you control which users and applications have access to your Twilio Account's API resources

access.quote: Sign up for a free Twilio account and grab one of our official server-side SDKs to get started. Send your first text message, phone call, or email in minutes.

api.quote: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server gives AI coding agents direct, structured access to Twilio's full API surface—over 1,800 endpoints across 30+ products—without leaving your IDE.
